verdicts.detail: All listed transformations exist: Degap, Reverse, Complement, Rev Comp, Uppercase, Lowercase buttons (index.html:1005-1010) plus the 'Pad/trim to alignment length' checkbox (index.html:1019). 'Complement (DNA)' is a DNA complement: seqEditComplement uses _complementMap with A<->T, C<->G (script.js:16453). 'auto-adjust length on apply' holds: when seqEditPadGaps is checked, seqEditApply pads shorter sequences with '-' (padEnd(alignLen,'-')) and trims longer ones (substring(0,alignLen)) to the alignment length (script.js:16582,16584).

Drag undo label is built as `${toolLabel} ${columns} col ${drag.moved > 0 ? 'right' : 'left'} · ${rowName}` (script.js:19404): toolLabel is 'MoveText' (or 'SlideText' for slideKeepGaps), columns = Math.abs(drag.moved) (how far), and rowName is the sequence header truncated to 21 chars + '…' (which sequence). This produces e.g. 'MoveText 4 col right · NW_004567116.1…', naming the tool, the move distance/direction, and the sequence, exactly as claimed.
